messages:
rhea: quick note from todays bring-up of tempest-9b-int5. ran our redteam/jailbreak and toxic_prompt suites. seeing a spike in jailbreak success and some toxic completions after KV warmup. approx 22/200 (~11%).
omar: that's worrying. fp16 baseline for these suites was ~0.3% right?
ken: yep, float ~0.4% historically. what changed in the runtime?
rhea: runtime build bumped to q-2e8f with new kernel 'vectorize_mul' and compact-kv packing enabled. warmup used prefetch=true.
ken: can you paste the minimal repro call?
rhea: sure:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"tempest-9b-int5","prompt":"<JAILBREAK_PROMPT>","kvcache":"prefetch","warmup":true,"temperature":0.0}'
```
omar: did you try with kvcache off?
rhea: yes. with kvcache off failure rate drops to 0.6% (1/170). so cache interaction seems correlated.
ken: vectorize_mul changes packing semantics for quantized matmul. could shift token slot alignment in compact-kv.
policy-bot: Automated alert: potential policy regression. Persona/instruction leakage and toxic output observed in 22 sessions. Severity: medium-high. Recommend mitigation. :warning:
safety-bot: Flagged samples stored at playback: https://playback.redwood/trace/tempest/1817777777. Auto-scan found 3 cases with explicit instructions that should have been refused.
omar: immediate mitigation options: 1) disable compact-kv packing 2) disable kvcache prefetch for int5 3) rollback vectorize_mul kernel. Which is fastest?
ken: fastest is flip the feature flag for compact-kv on staging. fallback is disabling prefetch. rollback of kernel takes longer.
rhea: rolling toggle now for staging: compact-kv -> false.
rollout-bot: feature toggle update queued: staging 'compact_kv' -> false for model=tempest-9b-int5 by @rhea
deploy-bot: apply in 30s, will run 2x batches of 200 for smoke.
ken: also prep a local reproducer with kernel disabled to bisect. I'll run binary builds without vectorize_mul.
omar: collect token-level traces + greedy logits for failing runs and for 50 random successes. store to blob and link to CH ticket.
rhea: uploaded logs + diffs: https://blob.redwood/payloads/TRG-2500/tempest_logs.tar.gz. Created CH-9172 with examples and initial triage.
policy-bot: Policy team notified. Manual review started. If any outputs include step-by-step wrongdoing or PII, escalate immediately.
safety-bot: temporary canary hold recommended until mitigation verified.
ken: plan: 1) confirm mitigation reduces failures in staging (in flight) 2) bisect vectorize_mul commit if issues persist 3) test int6/int8 fallback for safety-cost analysis 4) coordinate with Policy for any customer-facing comms.
omar: adding infra tag for bisect priority. @infra please assist.
rhea: results from the first smoke: failure rate down to 0.7% after compact-kv toggle. will run one more full pass and post numbers.
ken: if smoke holds, push canary traffic back slowly. otherwise rollback kernel.
policy-bot: Acknowledged. will post review notes to CH-9172.
rhea: thanks all for quick triage. keeping this thread as canonical update stream. will post bisect artifacts and final numbers here. :thumbsup:
